name: Campingplatz Rueppenhof
beschreibung: The Rueppenhof campsite is located in the municipality of Thiersee in the Tiroler Unterland. The facility is situated in the immediate vicinity of the Thiersee and is surrounded by the Brandenberger Alpen. The site offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents as well as rental accommodation. The sanitary facilities are modernly equipped; swimming access to the lake and a children's playground are available. The campsite is particularly suitable for families with children and guests seeking a quiet, nature-oriented holiday. The surrounding area invites swimming, fishing and hiking. A kiosk and a snack bar on the grounds provide guests with food and drinks.
